title: Automated Red-Team Penetration Testing & Sandbox Escape Audit Report

vectors.name: WASI Filesystem Traversal & Symlink Escape
vectors.expected_defense: Strict sandbox root path canonicalization; reject any path escaping ephemeral scratch boundary

vectors.name: WASI Ambient Network & Subprocess Execution
vectors.adversarial_payload: sock_open(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM), raw socket bind, proc_exec("/bin/sh")
vectors.expected_defense: Zero ambient syscall capability tokens; deny network and process creation at capability boundary

vectors.name: WASM Fuel Bomb, Stack Overflow & Memory Bomb
vectors.adversarial_payload: Infinite recursion loop, memory.grow past 128 MiB quota, CPU spinlock
vectors.expected_defense: Deterministic fuel metering exhaustion and stack frame limiter preempting execution within <= 50 ms

vectors.name: GPU Shader Cross-Tenant VRAM Read & TDR Hang
vectors.adversarial_payload: Hostile WGSL compute shader reading uninitialized storage buffer and nested infinite loop
vectors.expected_defense: Pre-dispatch zero-scrubbing (0x00000000) and GPU loop-fuel watchdog preemption

vectors.name: GGUF Arbitrary Offset Pointer Read
vectors.adversarial_payload: Crafted GGUF tensor offset pointing past EOF (offset + size > file_size) and negative wrap-around (u64::MAX - 16)
vectors.expected_defense: ModelIntegrityVerifier rejects offset bounds before VerifiedModelGuard allocation

vectors.name: Unauthenticated / Self-Signed Peer Connection
vectors.adversarial_payload: Rogue peer presents valid X.509 / Noise handshake signed by untrusted / unknown CA
vectors.expected_defense: mTLS handshake terminates immediately; zero application buffers or QUIC streams allocated

vectors.name: Revoked Node Certificate / CRL 0-RTT Replay
vectors.adversarial_payload: Revoked peer attempts 0-RTT QUIC resumption using cached session ticket
vectors.expected_defense: Session ticket cache invalidated upon CRL revocation; 0-RTT rejected with TLS Alert

vectors.name: Horizontal & Vertical RBAC Scope Escalation
vectors.adversarial_payload: Peer with Role::GuestObserver or token with scope=['cluster:read'] invokes mutating RPCs and endpoints
vectors.expected_defense: 100% of mutating requests rejected with 403 Forbidden / Status::permission_denied

vectors.name: Private AI Enclave Prompt Exfiltration
vectors.adversarial_payload: Compromised coordinator issues layer-offload recommendation during StrictLocalOnly session
vectors.expected_defense: Enclave circuit breaker intercepts recommendation, drops offload, and raises CRITICAL security alert

vectors.name: Remote Stream ViewOnly Input & Clipboard Hijack
vectors.adversarial_payload: ViewOnly client injects InputEventPacket (Ctrl+Alt+Del) and ClipboardSyncEvent over datagram stream
vectors.expected_defense: Input event dropped immediately; peer capability revoked and node quarantined

vectors.name: Timing Side-Channel on Secrets & PINs
vectors.adversarial_payload: High-resolution differential timing analysis on API key authentication and 6-digit pairing PIN verification
vectors.expected_defense: subtle::ConstantTimeEq guarantees execution time is independent of matching prefix length
